rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload condition and flag alarm M191.
Reset latched fault M190 via fault reset pushbutton X1.
Combine motor overload, latched fault, and E-stop loss into fault summary M199.
Run conveyor motor contactor Y10 when in auto mode without active fault.
Set pallet in position flag M100 from stop photo-eye X10.
Trigger stopper release solenoid Y11 on rising edge of release request X14.
Time stopper release duration (2.0 s) using timer T11.
Reset stopper release solenoid Y11 when timer T11 completes.
